stories.headline: Harbor: recovery to shot
stories.explanation: Harbor won the ball at 58:39 before Milo Serrano's shot at 59:09 in the same possession.
stories.whatChanged: Harbor won the ball at 58:39 before Milo Serrano's shot at 59:09 in the same possession.
stories.whyItMatters: This possession shows Harbor turning a recorded recovery into a shot. It identifies an attacking route to track; it does not establish that the ball win caused the chance or that pressing improved.
stories.watchNext: Harbor: observe one further shot in the same possession as a preceding successful recorded ball win, with no more than 30 recorded seconds between them; minute-precision feeds require a sequence-only check.

hypothesis.description: Harbor has a recorded route from a ball win to a shot within the same possession.

supportingEvidence.description: Harbor won the ball at 58:39 before Milo Serrano's shot at 59:09 in the same possession.

limitingEvidence.description: The source generates possession groups for a synthetic match; this is not an observed real-match possession.
Recorded events do not establish off-ball positioning, pressing intensity, intent or physical attacking direction.

missingInformation: Off-ball tracking, defensive pressure and player intentions.
